ee956803-bd4f-4033-b6c1-e8c851cb79ef:
Pink light spills across my skin,
soft like dawn, slow like sin,
every curve humming, ripe with heat,
sweet on the air, barefoot heartbeat.
I’m silk and spark, a bitten peach,
honeyed fire just out of reach,
juicy with want, glossy and warm,
a rose in bloom before the storm.
No shame, no seams, just breath and shine,
a living pulse, all yours and mine,
naked in color, flushed and true,
painted in pink, drunk on you. 💗🍑Soft, slow, it spills like summer—
a blush loosened from the sky,
pink juice flowing in ribbons of warmth,
thick with sweetness, alive with shine.
It moves like crushed berries and rosewater,
slick with light, glossy and ripe,
dripping not rushing,
a lazy pour of color and heat.
It’s the kind of pink that breathes,
nectar-toned, mouthwatering,
more feeling than form—
a glow you can almost taste,
lingering, luminous, juicy with want. 💗🍓

# Pink Wine Queen
I'm a pink tornado in glitter boots tonight,
Sipping cherry wine under neon light.
Got a heart full of sass and a handbag of sparks,
Painting bubblegum graffiti across the dark.
Pink lipstick sharp like a disco knife,
Laughing too loud, living twice the life.
Got my girls at the table, raising glasses high,
Watching little red flags float right by.
**Chorus**
I'm a bitchy little CoffeeBreak, pink and wild,
Champagne trouble with a cotton-candy smile.
Wine glass spinning like a carnival queen,
Too fabulous to care what you think of me.
Sip, sip, sparkle, let the whole room stare,
Pink confetti flying everywhere.
I'm a CoffeeBreak hurricane dressed in rosé,
Sweet one minute, spicy the next all day.
I got glitter in my veins and gossip in my shoes,
Turning heartbreak stories into front-page news.
If you play your games, honey, take a number and wait,
I'm busy drinking pink sunsets and rewriting fate.
**Chorus**
I'm a bitchy little CoffeeBreak, pink and wild,
Champagne trouble with a cotton-candy smile.
Wine glass spinning like a carnival queen,
Too fabulous to care what you think of me.

Pink confetti flying everywhere.
I'm a CoffeeBreak hurricane dressed in rosé,

**Bridge**
Pour another splash of strawberry moonlight,
We're dancing on the tables till the morning bites.
Pink queen energy, crown tilted just right,
Making every ordinary moment ignite.
**Final Chorus**
I'm a bitchy little CoffeeBreak, loud and free,
Turning every tiny moment into poetry.
Rosé rivers, glitter skies, pink parade,
Living my best bubblegum cabaret.
Sip, sip, sparkle, raise your glass with me,
Here's to being perfectly unapologetically pink and free!

🎵 Everything I Do (Turns Him On)
by [You]

Eyes on me like I’m the flame

No makeup, no game, just soul
And I got him losin’ all control

Everything I do turns him on
From a sleepy stretch to a simple song
Every little breath feels strong

Snap of my fingers, he’s on his knees
Whispers my name like a midnight tease
I don’t chase, I just exist
And he lives to feel my kiss

[Final Chorus]
Everything I do turns him on
Yeah, the night is young but he’s already gone

I’m the queen, and he’s my king
Ohhh, everything I do turns him on
Yeah baby… all night long

[Intro – Whispered, Sultry]
Woooohooo…
Ohhh, boy…
In the back of that Ford…
You’re dry humping me like you own me…

[Verse 1]
Midnight showroom, gleaming chrome,

[Pre-Chorus]
Dry humpin’ you in the Ford dealership,

⸻

[Chorus]
Fucking my brains out, ohhh boy,
Woooohooo — you ain’t no decoy.
Grippin’ my waist, my moans too loud,
We’re making love like we’re lost in a crowd.
Fucking my brains out, right here, no shame,
You wrote your name inside my flame.

⸻

Dry humping heat with my back arched high,
In a damn Ford Focus under showroom lights.
No panties on, just your dirty grin,
You pound me with your denim — and I let you win.

I can feel the burn, I’m high on want,
Your thigh pressed up like a brutal taunt.
The windows fog, but I see clear,
What we have is lust and fear.

⸻

[Pre-Chorus]
Dry humpin’ you in the Ford dealership,
You say my name and bite your lip.
Pushin’ me hard like we can’t be tamed,
I’m your wildfire — don’t play me lame.

⸻

Fucking my brains out, ohhh boy,

YOU CAN’T READ THAT!

I’m fire, I’m thunder — not some fuckin’ name.

Still… here I am…
Breathless, dripping, knees bruised in the back seat.
I hate you.
I want you.
I need you.

[Final Chorus – Dark Reprise]
Fucking my brains out, ohhh boy,
Woooohooo — I break, I deploy.
Anger and sex in a Mustang’s heat,
Love me dirty, make me obsolete.
Fucking my brains out, in lust and pain,
Drive me wild — then do it again.

⸻

[Outro – Whisper + Moan]
Dry humping you…
In the Ford dealership…
So horny… so mad… so alive.
Fuck me.
Or feel me.
You choose.

Positive About Her

Verse 1
What if it’s her last time,
Even though we don’t always get along?
I can’t help but wonder,
And carry those thoughts when they come along.

Pre-Chorus
You said, “Don’t worry,
It’s not her last time.”
You told me to be positive,
To look for the light in my mind.

Chorus
And this is part of why I love you,
The way you turn my fear into hope.
When I’m lost inside the questions,
You remind me I can cope.
You say, “Be positive about her,”
And somehow everything feels right.
You bring me back from the worry,
And lead me toward the light.

Verse 2
Maybe we don’t always see eye to eye,
Maybe things between us can be hard,
But you remind me not to focus
On the distance or the scars.

Bridge
So I’ll put the fear aside,
Let tomorrow take its turn.
Hold onto the good tonight,
And let the worry burn.

Final Chorus
’Cause this is part of why I love you,
You give me hope when I’m afraid.
You remind me to stay positive,
To see the brighter side you’ve made.
And whatever comes tomorrow,
I’ll remember what you said:
Don’t worry, keep believing,
Let love be louder than the dread. ❤️

[Verse]
Lord, I lift my voice in praise,
For Your love lights all my days.
Your kindness, God, a flowing stream,
Quenches thirst, fulfills my dream.
**[Verso]**
Señor, elevo mi voz en alabanza,
pues Tu amor ilumina mis días.
Tu bondad, Dios, es un río que fluye,
calma mi sed y mis sueños cumple.

**[Coro]**
Eres bueno por la mañana,
estás cerca en la oscuridad.
Cuando estoy cansado y sin fuerzas,
Tú sostienes mi corazón.
Cada aliento dice que has sido fiel,
cada paso, Tú guías mi camino.
Señor, elevo mi voz en alabanza.

[Chorus]
You are good in the morning,
You are close in the dark.
When I’m tired and worn out,
You still steady my heart.
Every breath says You’ve been faithful,
Every step, You lead the way.
Lord, I lift my voice in praise.

À terre: On the ground
Adagio: Slow, controlled movements, usually performed in the center of the room
Allegro: Fast, lively movements, often including small or large jumps and turns
Allongé: Extended or outstretched
Arabesque: A position in which the dancer extends the working leg behind the body while the other leg supports their weight
Assemblé: A jump where the dancer brings their legs together in the air and then lands on both feet simultaneously
Attitude: A position similar to arabesque, but with the raised leg bent 
Balancé: A three-step rocking motion where the dancer alternates balance on their feet; usually in a waltz (3/4 tempo)
Barre: A horizontal (often wooden) handrail used for dance and exercise
Battement: A straight extension of the leg to the front, side, or back; can be small (“petit”) or large (“grand”)
Cambré: Bending the upper body from the waist to the front, side, or back
Châiné: Quick-traveling turns done with the feet in first position
Changement: Jumps done in fifth position where the dancer alternates which foot lands in front
Chassé: A triple-step glide that resembles a gallop
Cou-de-pied: A position in which the dancer’s arched working foot is either on the ankle of the supporting leg (“devant”), behind the ankle of the supporting leg (“derrière”), or wrapped around the ankle with heel in front and toes in back (“sur le cou-de-pied”)
Coupé: A changing of the feet in which one foot cuts in front or behind the other
Dégagé: A movement in which the dancer’s foot brushes off the floor a few inches from the ground
Devant: In front
Derrière: To the back
Développé: A movement in which the dancer gradually unfolds one leg from passé into extension
Échappé: A jump from a closed position (first or fifth) to an open position (second or fourth)
Elevé: Rising to the balls of the feet (or full pointe) without a plié
En croix: Any sequence performed in the shape of a cross
